memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “The integrity of the upright guides them.”  Proverbs 11:3

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Truth, integrity, and progress are three divine steps that shape a person’s spiritual success. Truth may delay, but it never dies, it stands firm. God values a truthful heart more than any gift we offer.

Moses’ life stands as a powerful pillar of truth. His obedience flowed from a heart rooted in truthfulness, and this truth helped him endure strong opposition without wavering. From Pharaoh’s threats to the murmuring of his own people, Moses remained calm, steady, and anchored in truth. His quiet strength was the fruit of deep integrity. Because of this unwavering truthfulness, God entrusted him with one of the greatest leadership roles in history.

Job also stands as a brave and strong witness of integrity. In the midst of severe trials, losses, and accusations, he remained upright and uncompromising. His integrity became his lifelong testimony. Even today, his witness still speaks, encouraging believers to stay firm in testing.

Truth makes a person trustworthy before God and man. Integrity guards the heart from hidden failures. Every true progress begins with inner purity, not outer achievements. When a believer chooses truth over convenience and integrity over compromise, God Himself releases progress and uncommon favor.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Integrity is the foundation of all true greatness.”  Charles H. Spurgeon

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, fill my heart with truth, strengthen me in integrity, and lead me into the progress You have prepared for my life. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May God clothe your life with truth and integrity.
May His mighty hand lead you into divine progress.
